notes.title: Blasten!!'s Super Amazing Nextfest Broadcast with Free Beer and Peanuts Part 2
notes.notes:
Hello party people! The Blasten!! team is proud to present our first ever livestream, taking place at the fabulous NextFest event.

At this event, we'll be debuting the Weather boss level. Blasten must navigate through a movie studio gone berserk, which is strange because aren't the actors still on strike?

Afterward we'll introduce the team, field questions about the game, and work on the day's Wordle if we have extra time.

notes.title: Random Wednesday Night Demo Playthrough ||
notes.notes: Hello campers! We're going to play through the Blasten demo. This is definitely not because we've never done a live stream before, and don't want to look even more like idiots at NextFest.
